notes.title: New H1 "Wisdom" & Vaasi Suit Skin for Iune
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/6a1c46a174ba96bd8e897f3e3b3ec54cf6f3a269.jpg[/img]

Iune is Raiders of the Broken Planet resident healer. Besides her immense Aleph-infused powers, her grasp to reality seems to be a bit tenuous at times. Thus, the other Raiders didn’t raise an eyebrow when she appeared one day wearing what it seemed to be a dead fish’s skin. 

But it all made perfect sense for Iune. Being a kind (if confused) soul as she is, Iune wanted once to help a vaasi -a flying fish native to the Broken Planet- to find its mate. The fact that the fish had been dead for quite some time didn’t seem to trouble Iune that much, and thus she carried its remains with her everywhere.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FpFjSgX-kWA
After a while, Iune forgot why she was wearing a dead fish’s skin over her head, but by that time she had grown used to it and decided to further embellish it with some Anhuari trinkets. Some days later, when the stink was hard to ignore anymore, Iune realized she should probably wash it. Iune’s Vaasi Suit skin is now available for 1.200 Mercury Points. 

Along with the Vaasi Suit skin, Iune now has access to a new carbine, the H1 “Wisdom”. When Iune became skilled enough to become an Emnu Nadi, her mastery over the Aleph was beyond any other being’s. It was then when Iune realized she could imbue her weapons with her inner energy; She commanded, and the Aleph obeyed. Iune could now focus her own conscience into the bullets shot by her H1 “Wisdom” carbine, willing them to explode when they found their way into her enemies’ heads. 

The H1 “Wisdom” carbine’s blueprint can be obtained in the The Enemy Within mission from the Alien Myths campaign. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/489a5215d87846b09e7b76a1e5fb5b465f35375a.jpg[/img]

[b]This Troublesome New Character is Available Today for Use in All Raiders of the Broken Planet Campaigns[/b]

A new playable character is joining Raiders of the Broken Planet: the psycho-nerd hacker Schneider. This new Raider is the latest character to be released as part of Raiders of the Broken Planet´s third campaign, Hades Betrayal, and can be recruited by all players, irrespective of which campaign they own.

https://youtu.be/VLCym6TAji0
Know-it-all, rude, bratty and far too smart for his own good... Schneider doesn't give a damn what they call him, because he considers himself the future! Everyone else are just trained monkeys on the verge of going extinct. Schneider built his SCHN31D3r drone when he was just 14 years old, so hacking the Broken Planet’s ridiculous technology for the Hades Division was a piece of cake.

But having fallen from grace in the eyes of his former employers after the Hades Betrayal campaign events, Schneider has joined forces with Harec’s Raiders –much to his new teammates’ disgust– and players can now recruit him for their Raiders of the Broken Planet games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/b076957185e50a0331f318ea9aacb67318d551ef.jpg[/img]

In game, Schneider enjoys playing cat-and-mouse with his enemies, luring them to attack him and then trapping them in a deadly crossfire using his drone’s withering firepower. Playing as the Antagonist, Schneider can deploy his drone strategically to cover the Raiders’ objectives, preventing them from achieving their goals.

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/f4930e20e29e4b4a258368b7031d59fae05d4e3b.jpg[/img]
[b]Loaht’s “Cookie” Granade Launcher and Grendel Skin Discount[/b]

Loaht’s love for high-calibre weaponry and his dry sense of humour are well known. Thus, it’s no surprise that he affectionally dubbed his latest grenade launcher “Cookie”.  Officially designated as CLK-4R by Rough Dinamics ltd., this grenade launcher uses Plutonite rounds, a ferociously radioactive (and hugely expensive) mineral that can only be obtained in the Dorsa mines, in Pluto. When exposed to high temperatures, the Plutonite triggers a chain reaction culminating in several detonations. Loaht knew General Marmalade had been experimenting with Plutonite before he discovered the Aleph, and stole most of the General’s stock prior to defecting the Umbra Wardogs. 
You can get the “Cookie” Blueprint in the No Reservations map. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EmpK8nppAbo
This new weapon is a great match to Loaht’s Grendel skin. As Loaht grew more familiar with his power and gained more control over it, the beast’s skin started to grow scales and adopt a darker hue. Being tired of shredding his clothes whenever he transformed, Loaht contacted the Humblebee clan, famous for their ultra-elastic battle suits. The Raider chose a prototype painted a garish yellow hue. After all, what’s the point of wearing camouflage when you are a 4-metre-tall rampaging monster?

To celebrate the release of the “Cookie”, the Grendel skin is 30% off until May 27th.

notes.title: Co-op/Versus shooter Raiders of the Broken Planet is free to grab (and keep forever) for the next two days
notes.notes:
The problem with launching a multiplayer shooter is that players are part of the content. Without players, you’ve only got half a package, even if there is a single-player mode. MercurySteam’s Raiders of the Broken Planet (a Gears of War-styled co-op shooter with a light PvP twist) has always looked rather nice, but without people playing it, it’s a hard sell, and the game just never got off the ground.

In an attempt to zap some life back into Raiders in time for the next episodic campaign release, for the next two days, you can grab the entire game (including three DLC solo/co-op campaigns) free on Steam to keep forever. Grab it now, and you’ve got something for your crew to do over the weekend.

notes.title: New O. Tolchok E10 for Konstantin
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/796d441bfdda58c6e1a82d208bf7c2dd826eacbd.jpg[/img]

[b]Konstantin’s Ogon Tolchok E10 and Rusty Pilgrim Skin Discount. [/b]

Konstantin is rec’s right hand, charged with the strategic planning of missions and profiling new potential Raiders to join the cause. Today, he is getting a new powerful weapon to add to his already impressive arsenal: the Ogon Tolchok E10.

Konstantin used the Tolchok E10 in the battle for the Domos Bridge. On one end, the Fifth Council’s pursuing units. On the other, local families fleeing for their lives… and Konstantin, one of the few warriors able to hold off a full battalion of Council troops and live. But he wouldn’t have without his Tolchok. 

The Ogon Tolchok E10 uses spherical bullets covered with an elastic polymer and lead alloy. The energy released by the polymer after impacting a target can push a target several metres away. Konstantin put that feature to use keeping the Fifth Council units at bay while the families crossed the bridge to safety. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z4DSewpHPuI
You can get the O. Tolchok E10 Blueprint as a reward playing as the Antagonist.

This new weapon is a great match to Konstantin’s Rusty Pilgrim outfit. After his face-off against the Ginebra Hunter Killer unit, Konstantin left his Fifth Council allegiance in the past, along with most of his cybernetic body. Konstantin spent weeks crawling among detritus, trying to survive and rebuilding his shattered body with discarded components. 

In the time it took Konstantin to return to full functionality, he reflected on how Ginebra didn’t finish him off when she got her chance, and he vowed to live to see her freed of the Fifth Council yoke.

To celebrate the release of the O. Tolchok E10, the Rusty Pilgrim skin is 50% off until May 20th.

notes.title: Patch Notes 08
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/fd9e407abd8acbf6a7df82b732a5f92d1dd955c3.jpg[/img]

Hades Betrayal first data patch is mainly oriented to both bug fixing and mission balance.

[b]Ayana[/b]
                Ayana could throw her cable so far than she could instantly pull off the hooked enemy. We want players thinking up different strategies when using Ayana's power.
                - Greatly decreased distance at which she can throw her cable (-15 meters)

[b]Short-Fused[/b]
                Antagonist spawn points in this mission were a bit awkward. This prompted us to make a big revision of every Antagonist spawn point in the game, which will be coming with the patch after this one.
                - Antagonist spawn points have been reworked.

[b]A Fistful of Sand.[/b]
                The Protector's walk to the first phase lift still had too much impact on difficulty.
                - Decreased enemy spawn rate after finding the Protector.

[b]The Beast’s Lair[/b]
                Starting enemy difficulty would sometimes cause the Raiders to be stuck at the spawning point.
                - Decreased the initial number of enemies.

[b]A Low Blow[/b]
                The last phase is proving a bit too difficult. We're happy with the final horde of the level and the frenetic situations it creates. We want to boost those feelings, so Raiders end up screaming when completing the mission.
                - Decreased initial number of Hades Division soldiers of the final phase (-3).
                - Increased Wardog spawn rate when the Raiders arrive at the last barrier (+25%).
                - Decreased life points of the last barrier (-10%).

[b]Double Agent[/b]
                The first phase of the mission can sometimes drag for too long, with Schneider changing sides continuously so that the Raiders could neither win nor lose.
                - Decreased enemy spawn rate during the first phase when playing against an Antagonist (-15%).
                - Schneider will hack the consoles faster if the first phase drags out.
                - Reduced crystal laser-beams AoE.

[b]Character cards[/b]
                We want players having more options to configurate their favorite characters earlier than they currently are.
                - Decreased level requirements to draw and shuffle character cards (28/34/41/44 to 18/28/34/42)

[b]Melee combat[/b]
                We detected some situations in which melee rules could be inconsistent.
                - Several features and fixes have been implemented to improve melee consistency.

[b]XP Boost Packs[/b]
                - Previously, you could purchase 3 XP Boost for 12.000 Gold. Now you purchase 4 XP Boosts for 16.000 Gold.

[b]Bug Fixing[/b]
                - Fixed a bug causing Mikah's Overexposure talent give the decoy almost infinite regeneration.
                - Fixed a bug causing some O.Tsiklon shoots to disappear. 
                - Fixed a bug that made Shae's weapons' targeting unstable against Schneider's and Aneska's mechs.
                - Fixed a bug that made Shae's weapons' unable to target some extractors on Short-Fused.
                - Fixed a bug where the Antagonist's spawn points would cycle in the wrong direction on No Reservations.
                - Fixed a rare bug where the Beholder's tentacles could be destroyed in just one shot by any weapon.
                - Several fixes on bugs caused by host renegotiations.

[b]Get instant access to all the news, game lore and community announcements with the free Raiders of the Broken Planet Companion App, available now on the Apple Store and the Android Marketplace [/b]

MercurySteam today announced that the Raiders of the Broken Planet Official Companion App is now available for free on the Apple Store and the Android Marketplace.  Now, Raiders of the Broken Planet fans can enjoy instant access to all the news, special events announcements, and the game’s rich lore and character background information, never missing an update no matter where they are.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/589355434f551ff5e6538fdc25baa1d72179877a.jpg[/img]

“We are constantly updating the game with new content, including characters, weapons and lore” comments Enric Álvarez, Game Director, “and the Raiders of the Broken Planet Companion App will help our growing community to keep track with all the official announcements directly on their mobile.”

Download the Raiders of the Broken Planet Official Companion App for free: 

-	[url=https://itunes.apple.com/es/app/raiders-of-the-broken-planet/id1318263202?mt=8--] iOS version[/url]
-	[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mercurysteam.raidersofthebrokenplanet] Android version	[/url] 

Raiders of the Broken Planet third campaign, Hades Betrayal, launched on April 4th, including a radical overhaul of the game’s progression system that has been very well received by the community, significantly increasing the number of returning and new players in the game. “Our community is incredibly proactive and enthusiast about all the news we launch about Raiders of the Broken Planet,” continues Álvarez, “and the latest campaign has added thousands of new players to the game. This Companion App is the perfect way for them to explore the game in detail at their own leisure”

The Raiders of the Broken Planet Official Companion App is now available for iOS and Android devices. For more information, please visit Raiders of the Broken Planet’s website: http://www.raidersofthebrokenplanet.com.

notes.title: Patch Notes 07.2
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/db92b79e5e7cbc1f9b339581a226c90b5b3271b9.jpg[/img]

With all the changes introduced to the rewards system, playing as the Antagonist is now more popular than ever. This has repercussions all around the players' ecosystem and many of the changes here are a consequence of it.

[b]REWARDS[/b]
Playing as the antagonist is a challenge. The Raiders outnumber them 4 to 1 and most people will lose more than they win. And it should feel fine! Being the antagonist, is not just about victory. It is about delaying the Raiders and making their life difficult and we want to better reward that.

                - Decreased difference between high and low scores on rewards when playing as the antagonist. Overall antagonist XP gains have increased

[b]MISSION RENTING[/b]
With the release of Hades Betrayal we are also revisiting the renting system. We want to explore setups different than the current 49k/4h system and see how they work out. The goal as usual is to give users more options to enjoy Raiders of the Broken planet.

                - Reduced renting duration from 4h to 2h30m
                - Reduced renting price from 49000 Gold to 22000 Gold

[b]CARD SYSTEM[/b]
For people just starting with Raiders, there is no use for Faction Points (FP) until a few hours into the game. We want new players discover cards and shuffling much earlier than they currently are:

                - Decreased level requierements to draw Faction Cards from 5/11/17 to 5/8/11.
                - Decreased level requierement to shuffle Faction Cards from 22 to 12.

[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
When we moved from a pure Gold system into a Level plus Gold system, Wardogs kind of got the short end of the deal ;). The 3rd lowest level-requierement Wardog Raider was more demanding than the 4th lowest level-requierement Hades Raider, so we swapped that.

                - Mikah and HIVE Level and Gold requeriments have been swapped.


[b]PASSIVE STATS[/b]
We're closely monitoring the delicate balance between level progression feeling rewarding and being able to overcome level differences with other players with tactical and technical skill. For now, we are removing some passive power from the melee aspect of the progression.

                - Brute force and Resistance passives have decreased their effects by 25%

[b]INVITATIONS[/b]
The maximum number of invitations one can hold at a time is now 10, this allows us to increase invitation drop-rates and properly reward people who do use them.

                - Increased invitation droprate (+50%)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/fa4619951a11b5b3d8edb8dc849346d97b91c3a9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 08 Designers’ Notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/2ec6e47d4aa8f56235f360ab4092f3f1d60be6ce.jpg[/img]

Thanks to the great reception of the new campaign and the progression system, the design team has been able to gather a wealth of data in record time. This has helped us prepare a hot-patch, focused on improving match quality and the matchmaking system.

Many thanks to all of you for your enthusiasm!

---

[b]Aequilibrium[/b]
The inclusion of the new Aequilibrium system, alongside the fact that all players started at level 1, has clearly unbalanced the Aequilibrium groups to Raiders side. The current fast-leveling-up environment prevents players from having the desired control over their respective Aequilibriums.

                - Greatly increased the weight that Antagonist-affinity leveling up has on the Aequilibrium (+30%)
                - Greatly decreased the weight that Raider-affinity leveling up has on the Aequilibrium (-20%)

These changes respond to the current environment of the Aequilibrium and are not definitive. We will continue to tune these numbers as player behavior stabilizes.


[b]Match scoring[/b]
In their current state, scores aren't as diverse as we hoped for. Great games should be rewarded with higher scores, and right now it's hard to see a score of 8 even on a great performance.

                - Increased match time, Raider's deaths and completion bonus contribution to the final score.
                - Decreased difficulty contribution to the final score when not playing against an Antagonist.
                - Decreased Antagonist skill bonus contribution to the final score when playing against an Antagonist.


[b]Matchmaking[/b]
The matchmaking system has received a major update with the Hades Betrayal campaign. Matching players across all regions is more consistent and fair. We've also put in many optimizations that allow us to calculate more combinations in the same amount of time. The new leveling and crafting system has increased the pressure on the matchmaking system, and we are working hard on making sure the balance between waiting times, good latency and fair MMR matching is optimal.

                - Increased MMR restrictions to avoid high-level vs low-level player matches. 
                - Increased AI difficulty when playing against an antagonist with lower MMR.
                - Decreased AI difficulty when playing against an antagonist with higher MMR.


[b]Invitations system[/b]
We detected a large number of players who were gathering invitations without using them. Due to the nil value the player obtains by doing this, we decided to set a max number of invitations per player. When a player reaches that number, he will stop receiving invitations until he uses at least one. Of course, veteran players invitations won't be reduced to that number, but those players will have to start using them if they wish to receive more invitations.

                - Established a maximum amount of invitations the player can have. (10)

[b]
Major bug fixes[/b]
                - Fixed a bug that was causing Ayana to crash some games.
                - Hans' Ansgar "Warm" MM1 damage area didn't correspond to its visual FX.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/a8b4ff521e3dc50fd7dc25b8b49c1a28fa7d018e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hades Betrayal Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/74ce4305a24781df78776a7c7a6c83b01519c812.jpg[/img]

Hades Betrayal, the third premium campaign for Raiders of the Broken Planet, is available now. Just like the previous campaigns, Alien Myths and Wardog Fury, Hades Betrayal is available to purchase as a stand-alone campaign for just €/$/£9.99. 

You can check the Hades Betrayal First Look video here: https://youtu.be/AptRMsagDbo
Hades Betrayal includes four brand new epic story missions, playable in single-player, 4 player co-op or the intense 4 v 1 Antagonist mode, and a new exclusive character, the privateer Ayana. In this story arc, the Raiders will face the might of the Hades Division, the most powerful military organization in the galaxy led by General Krausher. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/18f9cfb605bd13b225c9761b8e6373cd5062cbb9.jpg[/img]

Harec and his Raiders must struggle to convince Ayana to betray the Hades Division and join the Raiders if they want to have a chance to prevent General Krausher from deploying a doomsday weapon that will tip the balance of power on the Broken Planet in his favor.

But those are not the only changes coming to Raiders of the Broken Planet. Hades Betrayal’s launch comes accompanied by a major overhaul to the Raiders of the Broken Planet’s progression and reward system, along with a visual redesign and inclusion of many new game features. Players will now be able to rank up to unlock new rewards, and with the new Forge system they can customize weapons obtained during the missions. 

https://youtu.be/nmlJ8gZR22w
“The team has spent hundreds of hours reviewing gameplay data and listening to the fans’ advice, and all the changes we have implemented into the game have been directly influenced by that feedback,” commented Enric Álvarez, Game Director. “Introducing all those changes to the game while working on arguably our most ambitious campaign to date has been a monumental task, but the team has exceeded themselves. Raiders of the Broken Planet is now a very different proposition from the game we launched last year and a much better game as a result.”

On behalf the MercurySteam team, thanks to the great Raiders of the Broken Planet community for helping us making a better game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/20a772397f0988387c4448f5d4d0e98b1506be49.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hades Betrayal Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/d7752dc852c91adb65985abb4ab53ff55603cb72.jpg[/img]

With the coming of the Hades Betrayal campaign on April 4, Raiders of the Broken Planet is going through massive changes with a big impact on second-to-second gameplay. But we also keep working on balancing and adjusting the characters and missions that came before.

Most prominently, Hans has been a top antagonist pick for too long, we’re making very aggressive changes to make sure clever management of the Jetpack differentiates good players from better ones. This should create clearer vulnerabilities that well-organized Raiders have a better chance to exploit.


[b]Missions: [/b] 


[i]Short-Fused[/i]

“The Raiders could cause the pilot to go for more Aleph during the first phase to have a full pool of lives in the second. That’s a fine but slow strategy, however, it was not dangerous enough. The tradeoff should be real now.”

- Increased duration of “Survival” situations on first phase.

- Increased bonus enemy spawn on Survival situations on first phase.

- Less enemies spawn ambushing the far-left side tank.


[i]A Fistful of Sand[/i]

“We detected a spike of defeats during the Protector’s walk to the lift, on first phase. Besides of that, the average time needed to complete the level was a bit long”

- Decreased the number of enemies spawned when you find the Protector (-2).

- Decreased duration of Protector’s spell casting (-20%).


[i]The Enemy Within[/i]

“We know the Uras is cool and we love him, but his phase had too much weight on mission difficulty when not playing against an antagonist.”

- Increased enemy spawn rate during the first phase when not playing against an Antagonist (+10%).

- Decreased enemy spawn rate during the second phase when not playing against an Antagonist (-10%). 


[i]No Reservations[/i]

“This level was too hard for low-mid skilled players and too easy for high skilled players.”

- Reduced waiting time at the bridges (-15 secs).

- Increased duration of the final phase (+10%).

- Decreased the speed of losing energy at low difficulties. (-10%).


[i]A Weapon from the Past[/i]

“The average time needed to complete this level was a bit short.”

- Decreased Lyras' Sphere bar’s speed (+15%).

- Fixed a bug where the Drone gained too much speed. 


[i]The Beast’s Lair[/i]

“Marmalade should be at least as cool as the Uras!”

- Decreased enemy spawn rate during the second phase when not playing against an Antagonist (-10%).

- Decreased waiting time on the bridge (-20%)

- Increased Marmalade’s life when not playing against an antagonist (+7%)

- Increased Marmalade’s life when playing against an antagonist (+15%) 


[b]Characters: [/b]


[i]Fifth council[/i]

“Shooter damage resistance is too big of a factor at high difficulties. Too much power on a faction-wide non-interactive stat shuts down too many opportunities for balancing overall.”

- Slightly decreased resistance to shooter damage (-5%) 


[i]Harec[/i]

“Harec’s damage has never been a tuning knob that we’ve been able to use much. One-shots don’t leave much room for damage improvements. They finally make sense now with the upcoming progression changes.”

- Increased Ferox Impetus' damage (+15%)

- Slightly Increased Vindicta Anima’s damage (+5%)

- Slightly Increased Ignis Fugit’s damage (+5%)

- Reduced Stalk cooldown (-10%) 


[i]Konstantin[/i]

“Tsiklon was too powerful at launch.”

- Decreased O.Tsiklon UV9's damage (-5%) 


[i]Alicia[/i]

“VINC Eager has been underperforming for far too long. It’s a pretty skill-intensive weapon for Alicia’s standards and definitely deserves the attention from those enjoy who wall-jumping aggressively.”

- Increased VINC "Eager" 23-1's damage (+10%) 


[i]Lycus[/i]

“Pepper Pot was too powerful at launch as well.”

- Increased Spinning Coin's damage (+5%)

- Decreased Pepper Pot's damage (-10%) 


[i]Hans[/i]

“As mentioned above, we believe the Jetpack is the best place to nerf Hans at this point. Skilled Hans players can, with good energy management, offset this drawback.”

- Ansgar "Warm" MM1 now takes an extra time before starting to deal damage (+0.2 secs)

- Heavily increased Jetpack reload time (+8 secs)

- Jetpack fuel lasts slightly longer (+7%) 


[i]Dr. Kuzmann[/i]

“Kuzmann’s Lichtbogen was performing outstandingly at high skill levels.”

- Decreased Lichtbogen ZXX’s indirect damage (-15%) 


[i]Mikah[/i]

“VK9-9 was not powerful enough for the precision it demanded.”

- Increased VK9-9’s damage (+10%) 


[i]Loaht[/i]

“Timing and positioning are the key to a good Loaht beast form rampage. However, we want to see it happen more often, giving players more chances to show their decision-making skills.”

- Rage bar now increases faster with received damage (+15%)

- Increased Popcorns' damage (+10%) 


[i]Iune[/i]

“Iune is very dependent on the behavior of the rest of the team. There’s still a lot of way to go as far as Iune balancing goes, but for now, we’ll make her slightly more independent. Iune players need more repercussion on their own performance before we can properly asses her.” 

- Increased her converted grunt’s resistance to shooter damage (+10%) 


[i]Doldren[/i]

“Doldren’s performance in PvP is quite one-sided. Either he’s killing enemies with ease of being countered and hunted down with no means to escape. Skilled players have adapted quickly to it, but some mid-tier players still lack knowledge of Doldren’s strengths and weaknesses. We’ve worked on audio feedback to make that process easier. Also, Doldren was lacking power in PvE and the damage boost should help in that direction.” 

- New and reworked audio feedback on Doldren’s crawler ability.

- Increased JK-5’s damage (+10%)

- Increased Bloody Mary’s damage (+5%)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/fedfa27906bb4ca5275c3edb6a90b885e31c231c.jpg[/img]

[i]A Fistful of Sand[/i]

“We detected a spike of defeats during the Protector’s walk to the lift, on first phase. Besides of that, the average time needed to complete the level was a bit long”

- Decreased the number of enemies spawned when you find the Protector (-2).

- Decreased duration of Protector’s spell casting (-20%).


[i]The Enemy Within[/i]

“We know the Uras is cool and we love him, but his phase had too much weight on mission difficulty when not playing against an antagonist.”

- Increased enemy spawn rate during the first phase when not playing against an Antagonist (+10%).

- Decreased enemy spawn rate during the second phase when not playing against an Antagonist (-10%). 


[i]No Reservations[/i]

“This level was too hard for low-mid skilled players and too easy for high skilled players.”

- Reduced waiting time at the bridges (-15 secs).

- Increased duration of the final phase (+10%).

- Decreased the speed of losing energy at low difficulties. (-10%).


[i]A Weapon from the Past[/i]

“The average time needed to complete this level was a bit short.”

- Decreased Lyras' Sphere bar’s speed (+15%).

- Fixed a bug where the Drone gained too much speed. 


[i]The Beast’s Lair[/i]

“Marmalade should be at least as cool as the Uras!”

- Decreased enemy spawn rate during the second phase when not playing against an Antagonist (-10%).

- Decreased waiting time on the bridge (-20%)

- Increased Marmalade’s life when not playing against an antagonist (+7%)

- Increased Marmalade’s life when playing against an antagonist (+15%) 


[b]Characters: [/b]


[i]Fifth council[/i]

“Shooter damage resistance is too big of a factor at high difficulties. Too much power on a faction-wide non-interactive stat shuts down too many opportunities for balancing overall.”

- Slightly decreased resistance to shooter damage (-5%) 


[i]Harec[/i]

“Harec’s damage has never been a tuning knob that we’ve been able to use much. One-shots don’t leave much room for damage improvements. They finally make sense now with the upcoming progression changes.”

- Increased Ferox Impetus' damage (+15%)

- Slightly Increased Vindicta Anima’s damage (+5%)

- Slightly Increased Ignis Fugit’s damage (+5%)

- Reduced Stalk cooldown (-10%) 


[i]Konstantin[/i]

“Tsiklon was too powerful at launch.”

- Decreased O.Tsiklon UV9's damage (-5%) 


[i]Alicia[/i]

“VINC Eager has been underperforming for far too long. It’s a pretty skill-intensive weapon for Alicia’s standards and definitely deserves the attention from those enjoy who wall-jumping aggressively.”

- Increased VINC "Eager" 23-1's damage (+10%) 


[i]Lycus[/i]

“Pepper Pot was too powerful at launch as well.”

- Increased Spinning Coin's damage (+5%)

- Decreased Pepper Pot's damage (-10%) 


[i]Hans[/i]

“As mentioned above, we believe the Jetpack is the best place to nerf Hans at this point. Skilled Hans players can, with good energy management, offset this drawback.”

- Ansgar "Warm" MM1 now takes an extra time before starting to deal damage (+0.2 secs)

- Heavily increased Jetpack reload time (+8 secs)

- Jetpack fuel lasts slightly longer (+7%) 


[i]Dr. Kuzmann[/i]

“Kuzmann’s Lichtbogen was performing outstandingly at high skill levels.”

- Decreased Lichtbogen ZXX’s indirect damage (-15%) 


[i]Mikah[/i]

“VK9-9 was not powerful enough for the precision it demanded.”

- Increased VK9-9’s damage (+10%) 


[i]Loaht[/i]

“Timing and positioning are the key to a good Loaht beast form rampage. However, we want to see it happen more often, giving players more chances to show their decision-making skills.”

- Rage bar now increases faster with received damage (+15%)

- Increased Popcorns' damage (+10%) 


[i]Iune[/i]

“Iune is very dependent on the behavior of the rest of the team. There’s still a lot of way to go as far as Iune balancing goes, but for now, we’ll make her slightly more independent. Iune players need more repercussion on their own performance before we can properly asses her.” 

- Increased her converted grunt’s resistance to shooter damage (+10%) 


[i]Doldren[/i]

“Doldren’s performance in PvP is quite one-sided. Either he’s killing enemies with ease of being countered and hunted down with no means to escape. Skilled players have adapted quickly to it, but some mid-tier players still lack knowledge of Doldren’s strengths and weaknesses. We’ve worked on audio feedback to make that process easier. Also, Doldren was lacking power in PvE and the damage boost should help in that direction.” 

- New and reworked audio feedback on Doldren’s crawler ability.

- Increased JK-5’s damage (+10%)

- Increased Bloody Mary’s damage (+5%)

notes.title: New Raider: Ayana
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/675a99e0c0571ea3d231187df84049f30df1aa36.jpg[/img]

[b]Ayana Kwena joins the Raiders' ranks.[/b]
Hades Betrayal is almost here. Launching on April 4, the latest Raiders of the Broken Planet campaign includes Ayana Kwena as its exclusive character. As it was the case with Shae and Loaht in previous campaigns, you will recruit Ayana for your Raiders on Hades Betrayal’s first mission. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cWDbHyNYDxQ
Ayana is a renowned weapon for hire across the galaxy, and was actually the first name in Harec’s list when he started forming his Raiders, but he could hardly improve the lucrative Hades Division offering. Now, Harec is planning to bring down the mercenary army, and the time has come to force Ayana’s hand and make her join the Raiders… either if she likes it or not. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/6175176019d98de152801b1e442653c239345dca.jpg[/img]

“The most feared pirate in the seven galaxies", "Captain of captains", "The Flame"... Ayana is known by many names, all hard earned throughout her career. Originally from a poor land without much of a future, Ayana left at a young age in search of a better life, but she never forgot her roots. Today she is the captain of the Requiem, a space ship both respected and feared on a thousand planets. 

Ayana specializes in ship-to-ship boarding actions, and she has upgraded her combat uniform to include a boarding line rig that she uses to trap her enemies, leaving them defenceless in the process.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/74ce4305a24781df78776a7c7a6c83b01519c812.jpg[/img]

Ayana’s arsenal is composed by state of the art mortar rifles, using cutting edge pulse technology to fire self-propelled proximity mines. Ayana developed a fearsome reputation in boarding engagements where she used her mortar rifle to clear the deck of enemy elements before storming the bridge and taking the enemy ship.

notes.title: Hades Betrayal Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Hades Betrayal Campaign Coming to Raiders of the Broken Planet on April 4th![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/74ce4305a24781df78776a7c7a6c83b01519c812.jpg[/img]

The game’s third campaign comes accompanied by a totally overhauled progression system and new look and feel that changes the way Raiders of the Broken Planet is played!

Hades Betrayal, the third premium campaign for Raiders of the Broken Planet, will be launching on April 4th for PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. Just like the previous campaigns, Alien Myths and Wardog Fury, Hades Betrayal will be available to purchase as a stand-alone campaign for just €/$/£9.99.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/20a772397f0988387c4448f5d4d0e98b1506be49.jpg[/img]

Hades Betrayal includes four new, action-packed missions, all playable in either single-player, 4 player co-op or the intense 4 v 1 Antagonist mode, pitting the Raiders against the most powerful military organization in the galaxy: The Hades Division. Outnumbered and outgunned by General Krauser’s army, the Raiders’ only chance is to convince the mercenary outfit’s chief of security, Ayana Kwena, to betray the Hades Division and help defeat them from the inside, an impossible task for Harec and his allies.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/6175176019d98de152801b1e442653c239345dca.jpg[/img]

“In Hades Betrayal we delve into the military might of the Hades Division, and their plan to establish supremacy over all the Broken Planet,” said Enric Álvarez, Game Director. “The four intense missions included highlight the bitter rivalry that exists between the Division and the other factions, who are fighting over control of the Aleph production - something the Raiders must exploit if they want to stand any chance of succeeding in their mission!”  


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cWDbHyNYDxQ
Hades Betrayal’s launch will be accompanied by a major overhaul to Raiders of the Broken Planet’s progression and reward system, along with a visual redesign and inclusion of many new game features. Players will now be able to rank up to unlock new rewards, and with the new Forge system they can customize weapons obtained during the missions.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/9af004a2b40268f83e7b43aa5b84ce9fe9228704.jpg[/img]

The Antagonist role has also been redesigned, with them now receiving similar rewards to those obtained by the Raiders - Experience, Gold, Faction Points and Weapon Blueprints - based on the player’s performance during the game.  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/acde345176e8b0adc6cdc4417c24608a6f05015a.jpg[/img]

“When Hades Betrayal arrives, Raiders of the Broken Planet will effectively be a different game to the one we launched half a year ago,” adds Álvarez. “The changes we are introducing to the progression and reward systems are a direct result of player feedback gathered over the last six months. The fans are truly passionate about the game and being in touch with them daily allowed us to dramatically and radically improve our offering.  Raiders of the Broken Planet is now a much better game because of this. We also hope this shows our unflinching commitment with Raiders. The game will continue to receive new and better content over time as we work with our dedicated player base”

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/18f9cfb605bd13b225c9761b8e6373cd5062cbb9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Weapon for Mikah
notes.notes:
[b]The Shadow Raider skin is 40% off![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/18ea6704bacd8d6b2b26f37c3a5aface8307a2a5.jpg[/img]

The sneakiest Raider on the Broken Planet, Mikah, can now unlock a new weapon: the VK9-9. The blueprint to build this assault rifle can be obtained in the The Enemy Within mission. 

Mikah stole the VK9-9 assault rifle from GOSSAMER RINGS production facilities when they started the quality testing of this weapon before starting mass production for the Tarma Ilunaii army. This is an all-round rifle that can switch between semi-automatic and 3-round bursts.  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=no0UvToMOnE&feature=youtu.be
Also available today are 10 new Character Cards for Mikah! Personalize this former Hades Division stowaway and get an edge over your rivals.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/2ba9d1f4ea62dcda0ecd5690bfd7d249a25fcf57.png[/img]

On top of all that, Mikah’s rare skin, Shadow Raider, is 40% off until March 18. 
The “Echo” holographic device employed by Mikah was originally part of an experimental Hades Division Special Infiltration Operations suit. These suits never made it past the prototype stages, as the radiation emitted by the “Echo” bilocation vortex proved to be lethal for the test subjects. Mikah managed to get hold of a suit and modified it to reduce the radiation to tolerable parameters, at the expense of reducing the hologram’s resolution and resistance to damage.

notes.title: Rare Skins Discounted. Permanently!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/ed01718f4a2b846672e615c556351c8835db5c9a.jpg[/img]

Due to the success of the recent discounts on some of the most popular Raiders of the Broken Planet skins, MercurySteam has decided to permanently reduce the price on three rare skins by 50%: “Sabertooth” Heavy Armour, and Slave Unit, both for Ginebra, and Loaht’s Grendel. Additionally, those players who purchased those skins on or after February 12, will have 50% of their invested Mercury Points reimbursed!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gV9hQbkVBp8&feature=youtu.be

[b]Ginebra: Slave Unit[/b]

Dr. Pavel Kuzmann designed the vile Slave Unit Program. Using reanimated cadavers, Dr. Kuzmann cloned the minds of the best Fifth Council Hunter Units. These Slave Units could be controlled remotely by their originals, called Alpha Units, thus expanding their area of operations and reducing risks. Given Ginebra’s exceptional performance, the Fifth Council granted her control over several of such units.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/cd4b69ef666245baf048447dea12c1f2844dc6de.jpg[/img]

[b]Ginebra: “Sabertooth” Heavy Armour[/b]

When tasked with the elimination of high-risk targets by the Fifth Council, Ginebra donned the heavy Sabretooth battle chassis, including extra armour plating and a more aggressive outline, designed to intimidate her prey. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/2efbc18b615ff3b38bf41bbdc3c43c1ae9ea05cd.jpg[/img]

[b]Loaht: Grendel [/b]

As Loaht grew more familiar with his power and gained more control over it, the beast’s skin started to grow scales and adopt a darker hue. Being tired of shredding his clothes whenever he transformed, Loaht contacted the Humblebee clan, famous for their ultra-elastic battle suits. The Raider chose a prototype painted a garish yellow hue. After all, what’s the point of wearing camouflage when you are a 4-metre-tall rampaging monster?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/5f46a09e0b196b201fb62d8c51d1f686459cd6ba.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:
[b]The Walker From The Deep skin  is 50% Off![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/6d309c549ab59cc8b726613645e0df31e77b7b79.jpg[/img]

Ingrid is a Kelurian, an eel sub-species native to the Broken Planet. This dangerous aquatic creature can generate electromagnetic pulses to keep predators at bay. After the sinking of the SSV-N4vt1lvs submarine, Pavel Kuzmann was forced to walk through the depths of the Black Salt Sea, and Ingrid came to his aid when the Doctor was attacked by a Nilben -a creature that pre-digests its prey with acidic secretions. notes.notes:
[b]The Emnu Dagan Skin is 50% Off! [/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/48dfea64bb1c553a05874a07380bad99ccf76ef6.jpg[/img]

Shae’s new weapon, the Phax UTT-17 (Modified), is now available to unlock for all Raiders of the Broken Planet players. Shae’s weapon of choice when adopting the aspect of the Emnu Dagan was a modification of the Phax UTT-17. The Phax UTT-17 uses a shutter system to zeroing the objective. Shae connected the shutter to a pressure sensor, using the accumulated pressure, the shutter increases the weapon’s aiming speed. 

Shae also replaced the purge system for a progressive one, preventing the weapon from being completely depressurized when operated. All those changes and modifications obeyed a single purpose: to kill as many humans as possible. 

https://youtu.be/SUk-90t5fcA
To celebrate the launch of this new weapon for Shae, its accompanying skin, the Emnu Dagan, is 50% off until Sunday 4th of March!

Blind with grief and seeking revenge for her master’s murder, Shae started to raid human settlements, modifying her outfit to adopt the form of the Emnu Dagan. The Emnu Dagan is a demon from the local folklore, said to feed on his victims’ souls and crying tears of their blood after consuming them. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/6a97faf50f4f341e872cf45839858c54198b7941.jpg[/img]

Shae’s objective was not to exterminate the Terrans, but to instil fear and break their spirits. To that end she attacked by night and always made sure to leave one survivor. After a while, legends of a daemonic manhunter started to sow panic among the invading factions.

notes.title: Restrained Fury
notes.notes:
[b]The latest DevShouts video focuses on Loaht[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/5cf69d2780ffd07199ceb0eaa51f6b34c37dd8c1.jpg[/img]

Formerly of the Umbra Wardogs faction, Loaht is a failed genetic experiment -a by-product of General Marmalade’s early research with Aleph Plasma. Instead of dying a miserable death like so many other Umbra Wardog “volunteers” during the tests, something awoke inside Loaht -something powerful, dark and fuelled by rage.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/4ed1b5ff2e1dc2c4534d5292252ed3fafa40d1bd.jpg[/img]

Furious, Loaht broke free of the laboratory and tried to assassinate Marmalade but was forced to flee before completing his vengeance. After spending some time hiding from the Umbra Wardogs, his former colleague, Alicia, convinced him of joining the Raiders and help them stopping General Marmalade´s deranged plans

Loaht’s skills and weapons favour an aggressive style of gameplay, making him the ideal choice for clearing enemy groups around objectives and hunting down pesky Antagonists. In a new chapter of our #Devshouts series, Javier Gago, from our QA Team, unveils how to use his temperamental weapons and get the most out of his ability to turn into a huge beast and deliver a whole world of pain to his enemies.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oeuFSum7x9c
[b]Loaht’s custom-made suit[/b]

Loaht’s impressive alternate skin is dubbed “Grendel”. As he grew more familiar with his power and gained more control over it, the beast’s skin started to grow scales and adopt a darker hue. Being tired of shredding his clothes whenever he transformed, Loaht contacted the Humblebee clan, famous for their ultra-elastic battle suits. The Raider chose a prototype painted a garish yellow. After all, what’s the point of wearing camouflage when you are a 4-metre-tall rampaging monster?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/d7c6f5a88e6d759658e1feea3a56615f109d2d61.jpg[/img]

notes.title: An Exquisite Murderer: Doldren
notes.notes:
[b]This depraved killer Can Be Recruited for Use in All  Raiders of the Broken Planet Campaigns[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/2eac684fb9fb075efe92052c2d89668dae8c0424.jpg[/img]

A new playable character joins Raiders of the Broken Planet; the deranged assassin Doldren. This heartless killer can now be recruited by all players.

Doldren is a native to the Broken Planet but, unlike Harec or Iune who reluctantly abandoned their people’s peaceful ways to take arms against the Terran invasion, Doldren is considered an irredeemable monster among the culture that gave him birth. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/f7c8773e950b3a878e5aea454e87ce14f61bc9d0.jpg[/img]

His insatiable thirst for blood saw him jailed in the Pit of Repudiation, where he was to end his days in total seclusion, but when the invading humans assaulted the ancient gaol, Doldren was set free by his desperate captors as a final act of vengeance upon the Terrans.

For Doldren, the invasion of the Broken Planet is a blessing, as he can now put his talents for murder to use without fear of reprisal. Having heard of his dark reputation, Harec accepted him into the Raiders, acknowledging his usefulness as a peerless warrior, but the taciturn leader of the Raiders understands full well that Doldren might as well slit his teammates’ throats the moment he has no other victims within reach. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/4ee99f1bff14d42242ae5f58a9904a657f9cecb5.jpg[/img]

Doldren’s talents reside in his ability to ambush enemy forces, projecting his essence and rematerializing his body near unsuspecting foes, making short work of them with high-caliber revolvers or dealing the killing blow with his own hands. 

Lets us know what you think of Doldren and share your tactics with the Raiders of the Broken Planet community on [url=https://twitter.com/mercurysteam]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/mercurysteamsl]Facebook[/url]!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1D_bvK7pGAM&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: New Free Mission of the Week
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/d7752dc852c91adb65985abb4ab53ff55603cb72.jpg[/img]

[b]All players will have access to one premium mission every week. [/b]

Raiders of the Broken Planet is a campaign-based indie game with Triple-A production values that includes a starter campaign that players are be able to play for free and, if they like the game enough, invest 9.99€/$ in one of its premium campaigns.

Having a substantial part of Raiders of the Broken Planet offered for free, the game is labelled “Free to Play” in First Party game stores, and that has led to some confusion and discomfort among players who expected to find the usual F2P formula within.

For the game to progress, we need to satisfy that perception in a way that brings more players in and improves the game to be a better experience for all users.

We started by adding the possibility to play with all the game’s characters and interact with the progression and economy systems in the Eternal Soldier free starter campaign. Then we introduced the Invitation system and the Mission Unlocking for Gold. Now, we take a step further with the Mission of the Week.

From now on, all players will have access to one premium mission every week. This mission will rotate each week. This way, players who don’t own the premium campaigns will be able to play through the missions more easily, in addition to the current Mission Unlocking for Gold and the Invitation system. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/68efa23749a3705c2abe8f25ddc432f75ad84055.jpg[/img]

This will help bring in more players and open new possibilities to veterans:

•	As it has always been, only premium campaign owners can be awarded invitations. This is a key feature that eases progression and helps unlock new characters. 

•	Veterans will now have easier access to non-premium users who play the game and are hoping to be invited to other missions. These people will be easier to find; they will gather in the current Mission of the Week. 

•	Whatever map is currently chosen as Mission of the Week will have more players on it. This will lead to faster matchmaking times if you include that mission in your queue list. 

We’ll announce what new Mission of the Week is available every Monday in all our Social Media channels. This is just the first of the many major changes we are implementing in Raiders of the Broken Planet based in the players’ feedback. We hope you enjoy them!

See you at the Broken Planet.

notes.title: Faction Cards Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/de6308b641d44d7932d85762f0abbb2d5fb6abe2.jpg[/img]

[b]80 new Faction Cards are now available in Raiders of the Broken Planet, so you can give your Raiders the edge in battles![/b]

As the war for control of the Broken Planet intensifies, all four factions have been honing their martial skills and improving their strategies, and now they are deadlier than ever!

Today, MercurySteam has released a new Faction Cards pack, including 10 cards for each Faction plus their Rare counterparts. Now all Raiders of the Broken Planet players can customize their characters to suit any gaming style, either playing as Raiders or as Antagonists.

Each Faction Card is designed to subtly enhance the character’s performance during the game, while keeping the essence and character of the race it represents in mind. This way, the vengeful Locals will receive Cards like “Merciless”, that increases their weapons’ damage output after a kill (something Doldren will surely enjoy!), while the cold and calculating Fifth Council characters, like Konstantin and Ginebra, can deploy Cards such as “Firewall”, reducing the damage received when they have maximum health.

The Hades Division mercenaries, including Lycus and Mikah, also get their share of new Cards, like “Nerves of Steel” that allows them to reload faster after being hit, while the savage Umbra Wardogs can find “Kamikaze” among their Cards -increasing the damage of their first strike after performing a jump.

The new Faction Cards Pack for Raiders of the Broken Planet is now available for all players. Let us know your favourite character configurations and share them with the community on Twitter, Facebook and in the Raiders of the Broken Planet’s official forum.

See you on the Broken Planet.

notes.title: A First Look to the Hades Betrayal Campaign.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/90cd2ccc9ef1c710414577b043bf0521853fe462.jpg[/img]

Earlier this week we shared with you the Patch 07 Designers’ Notes that will include the rebalancing of some characters and missions. We expected V07 to go live today, but the submission process took a bit longer than expected and it will finally go out early next week. To make the wait more bearable, we’d like to share with you a sneak peek of what awaits us when the Hades Betrayal campaign arrives! (We’ll announce the release date in due time, no worries).

As you might have guessed, the third campaign will see the Raiders go head to head against the fearsome Hades Division, an elite mercenary outfit that previously counted Lycus, Hans and Mikah among their ranks. If Harec’s team is going to have any chance of defeating Krausher’s Hades Division, it will be by convincing her most trusted lieutenant, Ayana Kwena, to betray him. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/675a99e0c0571ea3d231187df84049f30df1aa36.jpg[/img]

But the Hades Division won’t be the only bad guys around! The Umbra Wardogs have a long-standing enmity with the Hades Division, stretching way back from the days before the Broken Planet’s invasion.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/210733272da7e68a83c1200333c63f95efa49ba7.jpg[/img]

The Hades Betrayal campaign will feature an incredible level of visual variety, and our concept and environment artists have outdone themselves creating really moody, evocative landscapes never seen before on the Broken Planet.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/7ca2b808ad3f25ce8c70f5c575d73aa23cb3912f.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/3b85f7fa1c3eee78adffba41b62774ef1b1bf28e.jpg[/img]

As usual, our concept artists put an incredible attention to detail when designing the Raiders’ weapons, making them look exotic and futuristic while retaining a sense of functionality and authenticity. Which Raider will be using of this pistol?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/52f57b98f0cec6ee82bc7d65e320facc492aef37.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/3ba889ae0e226ad9140cd8677ebdf4dc11d912d7.jpg[/img]

And of course we have the missions themselves. Our designers are putting the finishing touches to the most hard-fought and dangerous battles to date! Will the Raiders be able to defeat the best equipped fighting force in the galaxy?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/2460aeb5915cd04892d9d2f80312145f99384128.jpg[/img]

Lastly, as was the case with the previous campaigns, we’ll meet new Raiders who will join the team in their guerrilla war against the human invaders, each with their unique fighting style and special abilities. Now, who is this guy exactly? 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/ad258a02db06b92096a623f37baebe64e597642a.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now. If you enjoyed this Spoiler Alert Special, let us know on Twitter and Facebook and we might come back with a sequel soon!

See you on the Broken Planet, Raiders.

notes.title: Patch 07 Designers’ Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/26e71872975bab3564ac7f3ca8d78b9cd3ec7fb9.jpg[/img]

We are just a few days away from the newest [b][i]Raiders of the Broken Planet[/i][/b] update, taking the game to its V.07  version.

This update is focused on rebalancing some missions and characters to accommodate the new content we have released since the Wardog Fury campaign launched - Including new characters, weapons and Cards. V.07  also serves as a bridge to a major update we are working on, that [b]will radically change the Raiders of the Broken Planet’s progression and economy system[/b], and includes one big change that we will announce by the end of the week. 

We expect V.07 to go live by the end of the week, once the First Party submission process has gone its way - we’ll announce it via all our social media channels. In the meantime, let’s have an in-depth look to the different tweaks and rebalancing included in the update.

The design team is happy with the new characters’ performance and how they have been integrated into the game’s ongoing ecosystem. However, we have detected significant differences on some missions: some are too easy to beat, while others have a very low victory rate. We've have analyzed where those defeats occur and moved difficulty spikes towards mission parts that are deeper or more interesting to play.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/d7752dc852c91adb65985abb4ab53ff55603cb72.jpg[/img]

[b]Missions[/b]

[i]In Shock[/i]

  - Increased enemy spawn rate during the first phase (10-15%).

  - Rebalanced some values of Shae's electrocution.

  - Increased Dr. Kuzmann's life when not playing against an Antagonist (5%).

  - Increased Dr. Kuzmann's Tesla ground attack damage (10%).

  - Increased number of enemies per spawn on Dr. Kuzmann combat (+1) 


[i]A Breath of Hope[/i]

  - Decreased the number of Aleph charges needed on first monolith when 
    playing against an Antagonist.

  - Decreased the number of Aleph charges needed on second monolith.

  - Increased the number of Aleph charges needed on third monolith.

  - Increased the waiting time on monoliths when not playing against an 
    Antagonist (10%)

  - Increased enemy spawn rate during the monolith phases (10%-15%).

  - Increased bonus enemy spawn on Survival phases when not playing 
    against an Antagonist (20%).

  - Increased Guardian regeneration when playing against an Antagonist 
    (5%). 


[i]A Fistful of Sand[/i]

  - Increased enemy spawn rate during the first phase when not playing 
    against an Antagonist (7%).

  - Decreased the Protector's shield (10%).

  - Increased the Protector's life (5%).

  - Decreased the number of enemies spawned when you find the Protector 
    (-1).


[i]The Enemy Within[/i]

  - Increased enemy spawn rate during the first phase when not playing 
    against an Antagonist (5%).

  - Increased Drone life when not playing against an Antagonist (5%).

  - Reduced Drone spawn rate when not playing against an Antagonist (5%).

  - Reduced Council's progress bar speed when not playing against an 
    Antagonist (10%).

  - Reduced Uras-Beherit life when not playing against an Antagonist (5%).

  - Reduced the number of Aleph charges needed to activate the Uras-
    Beherit when not playing against an Antagonist (-1).

  - Increased the amount of time the Uras-Beherit stays activated when not 
    playing against an antagonist (10%).

  - Reduced the number of enemies at the first phase initial spawn when 
    playing against an Antagonist (-1).

  - Increased enemy spawn rate when playing against an Antagonist (10%).

  - Reduced Drone life when playing against an Antagonist (5%). 


[i]Short-Fused[/i]

  - Reduced Loaht's house resistance when not playing against an Antagonist 
    (10%).

  - Reduced enemy spawn rate during the second phase when not playing 
    against an Antagonist (5%).

  - Reduced the number of enemies at the second phase's initial spawn when 
    playing against an Antagonist (-1) 


[i]No Reservations[/i]

  - Reduced waiting time at the bridges (-5s).

  - Reduced enemy spawn rate during the second convoy (5%).

  - Reduced enemy spawn rate during the third convoy when not playing 
    against an Antagonist (20%).

  - Reduced enemy spawn rate during the third convoy when playing against 
    an Antagonist (10%).

  - Increased fart duration by 10%. (I love my job)

  - Reduced firing rate of Wardog gunship during third convoy.

  - Increased duration of the final phase (10%).


[i]A Weapon from The Past[/i]

  - Increased the Drone's life (5%).

  - Increased the Drone shield's turning speed (5-10%).

  - Decreased Lyras' Sphere speed bar (15%).

  - Increased enemy spawn rate during second phase (10-15%).

  - Increased engineer spawn rate (5%). 


[i]The Beast’s Lair[/i]

  - Increased enemy spawn rate during first phase (10%).

  - Decreased the number of enemies during the escape from the first phase.

  - Increased enemy spawn rate during Marmalade's first phase when not 
    playing against an Antagonist (20%).

  - Increased enemy spawn rate during Marmalade's first phase when playing 
    against an Antagonist (15%).

  - Increased Marmalade's damage (15%).

  - Decreased the number of enemies per wave during Marmalade's final 
    phase when not playing against an Antagonist (-1).

  - Decreased enemy spawn rate during Marmalade's final phase when not 
    playing against an Antagonist (10%).

  - Decreased the Aleph charges needed during Marmalade's final phase 
    when not playing against an Antagonist (-2).

  - Decreased engineer spawn rate during Marmalade's final phase (30%) 


[b]Characters[/b]

[i]Harec[/i]

  - Decreased Stalk's target acquisition time (-20%).

  - Increased Stalk's flying back speed when wounded (roughly +10%). 


[i]Hans[/i]

  - Increased Heaven's Bane K8's projectile speed (+45%).

  - Decreased Heaven's Bane K8's regular projectile explosion radius (-10%).

  - Increased Heaven's Bane K8's final projectile explosion radius (+5%).

  - Decreased Ansgar "Warm" MM1's damage (-15%).


[i]Lycus[/i]

  - Increased the kinetic Shield's capacity (+5%)

  - Increased the kinetic Shield's recharge speed (+7%)

  - Decreased Shit Happens's damage (-5%)


[i]Alicia[/i]

  - Walljump flotation lasts longer (roughly +15%)


[i]Dr. Kuzmann[/i]

  - Increased Light Horizons's healing power (+33%).

  - Increased Light Horizons's damage (+5%).


[i]Ginebra[/i]

  - Increased Javelin Ursa M-02's time between shots (+10%).

  - Decreased Javelin Ursa M-02's tension chargrup speed (+20%).


[i]Loaht[/i]

  - Increased Bubble Gum's time between shots (+50%).

  - Decreased Bubble Gum's ammo clip (from 5 to 4).


[i]Iune[/i]

  - Decreased Last Wish's Aleph pressure chargeup speed (-20%).

  - Increased The Vortex's Aleph pressure chargeup speed (+15%).


[b]Cards[/b]

[i]Iune[/i]

  - Increased Munificent's cooldown boost (roughly +20%).

  - Decreased Angelic's cooldown boost (roughly -15%). 


[b]"CrashDumps" [/b]

We have also included a new feature for the Steam version of the game to facilitate bug tracking. Now, the game will automatically save only the latest incidence, making it easier to track down when necessary and avoiding accumulating unnecessary data.

The path where the data is stored in is: "Documents\MercurySteam\Raiders of the Broken Planet\<steam-id>\CrashDumps

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/1ff79483c8cd4650838e2fecbfa7b41ae0c90299.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Pepper Pot Gun For Lycus
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/8355bc073eadd056413800b64dd91e1bf7d03f7a.jpg[/img]

During his years as Licaone Impure, the motorcycle gang he joined long time ago, Lycus suffered a lot of stress. The very idea of killing people from his motorcycle gave him goosebumps, but he barely hit a simple thing from the distance. 

That’s why he modified "Dolores", replacing its three barrels with just one with an internal valve-based closing mechanism. This way, the barrel closes with each reload and opens with each shot. As a result, the first shot from the clip barely spreads, which makes possible to hit a target at a certain distance and, of course, make Lycus happy in the process.

Also, Lycus' Space Biker skin makes the perfect match with this new Pepper Pot gun. That's why we have decided to offer it with a discount for a limited time. You can get this skin with a 40% off until Sunday, January 14.

notes.title: H.I.V.E. Infects Her Way Through the Broken Planet
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/00037be9f617132439636f20dc39fc3b6e5a5409.jpg[/img]

The Umbra Wardogs awaken a violent creature in the depths of the old Uddas Nassar Temple on the Broken Planet. With blood and sweat, they manage to capture her and take her to General Marmalade, who decided to use her as a weapon. But one day, without warning, the creature broke the chains and escaped, disemboweling anyone who tried to stop her.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HdnxWm2JTfQ
Nobody knows about H.I.V.E.’s origins, nor why she chose to join Harec’s Raiders and their rebellion against the invading humans, but there’s no doubt about this creature’s lethality. H.I.V.E. infects every weapon she touches, using them to impregnate enemies with pheromones. Then, the insect colony inhabiting her body, attracted by those pheromones, leeches away all the target’s life, returning to H.I.V.E.’s body and replenishing her own health.

H.I.V.E. can be recruited now for use in all Raiders of the Broken Planet campaigns.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/90e9079dcbf7d05894cae9d790fb10966775a38c.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:

Iune is the latest Raider to join Harec’s band of outcasts, hired guns and misfits is the first character to arrive after the release of Raiders of the Broken Planet´s second campaign, Wardog Fury, and can be recruited by all players, independent of which campaigns they own. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/aaa977084f00c2647453b06a8005a4c9312ee56b.jpg[/img]

Iune is a native of the Broken Planet, born with a gift that sets her apart from her people; she is an Anhauarii, a weaver of Aleph capable of miraculous feats. As was traditional under ancient law, Iune left her village to live as a hermit to perfect her skills, but then the Human invasion to the Broken Planet struck. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/d5e5b132744267df2d3735986e7575b8e50c7111.jpg[/img]

Armed with her hunting H1 carbine, dubbed “Last Wish”, Iune is a valuable addition to any Raiders team. Her formidable powers allow her to subvert her enemies’ will, forcing them to turn against their own comrades, whilst healing herself and her teammates.

notes.title: New Heaven's Bane Skin for Hans
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/db54aa40acaff943571e62f5360e9dcf1c6e88bf.jpg[/img]

Hans fought in the Succession War of the Pacific as a Heaven's Bane member, an elite squad that served the Unified New Asian Empire. His last mission was to assassinate one of the enemy leaders, famous for his fencing skills. Hans was haughty and young, so instead of finishing the  job shooting him in the head, Hans challenged him to a katana duel. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/dcacd154121d9f07fbab052d6652d9ac509be87e.jpg[/img]

Hans’ new Heaven’s Bane Skin is now available in [b]Raiders of the Broken Planet.[/b]

Wardog Fury includes four new epic story missions, all playable in single-player, 4 player co-op or the intense 4 v 1 Antagonist mode, and a new exclusive character. In this story, the Raiders will face the deranged General Marmalade and his Umbra Wardogs faction.

Raiders of the Broken Planet is available now on Steam, the Xbox Store and the PlayStation Store. The free Eternal Soldier campaign contains two missions, seven characters and sets the stage for the incredible story to follow. The first and second campaigns of the 2017 Season, Alien Myths and Wardog Fury, are available to purchase for €/$/£9.99 each. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/d278e07b7e0ee298a006a91d65d22cfa1693616b.jpg[/img]

Each campaign is its own self-contained story, allowing players purchase and play in any order, without needing to have played a previous campaign. Playing all four campaigns will reveal even more about the mysteries of the Broken Planet and the factions fighting for its control.

notes.title: Wardog Fury Campaign Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/1ff79483c8cd4650838e2fecbfa7b41ae0c90299.jpg[/img]

MercurySteam today announced that Wardog Fury, the second premium campaign for Raiders of the Broken Planet, will be launching on November 30th for PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. Just like the first campaign, Alien Myths, Wardog Fury will be available to purchase as a stand-alone campaign for just €/$/£9.99.

In Wardog Fury, Harec attempts to recruit Loaht, the genetic experiment that the leader of the Umbra Dogs, General Marmalade, created. Loaht has the ability to transform into a furious beast, powerful enough to rip apart the strongest of foes. With Loaht on his side, Harec can turn the tide of war in the Raiders’ favour. However, General Marmalade has plans to take all the Aleph on the Broken Planet for himself and to eliminate his rogue experiment in the process. With Loaht on the run, who will get to him first? Find out in the second chapter of the epic Raiders of the Broken Planet saga.

Launching on November 30th, Wardog Fury will include four new epic story missions, all playable in single-player, 4 player co-op or the intense 4 v 1 Antagonist mode. In this story, the Raiders will face the deranged General Marmalade and his Umbra Wardogs faction. Alicia knows first-hand just what this man is capable of and the rest of the Raiders are about to find out too. General Marmalade conducts narcotic and Aleph experiments on himself and his units, creating mutants that are as grotesque as they are deadly. Wardog Fury players will exclusively be able to recruit one of Marmalade’s rogue experiments, Loaht, in the first mission.

Also joining the fray during the Wardog Fury campaign are three more characters, who will be able to be unlocked by all Raiders of the Broken Planet players:

•	Doldren, a native of the Broken Planet who is lethal with a pistol or submachine gun, but even more deadly when he resorts to his bare hands.
•	Iune is another native to the Broken Planet, who has the special gift of the Anhaurii, meaning she can weave Aleph to grant her unique powers. In addition to her mystical powers, Iune enters combat armed with her hunting rifle.
•	H.I.V.E. is a strange creature that General Marmalade found lethargic in an old temple and attempted to enslave. Soon enough, H.I.V.E. broke free and ended up joining the Raiders. H.I.V.E.’s origins, or its reasons to align itself with the Harec’s band, remain a mystery.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZjaWuswZK2c

notes.title: Reward System Hot-Fix Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/0c4e271223a5f6335e86800dcc5c0911f4cf7a3e.jpg[/img]

[b]A word from the Design Team of Raiders of the Broken Planet on player's progression.[/b]

Dear Raiders,

As we have commented in our various social channels, we are closely tracking player progress in the live servers and keeping an eye on your feedback and suggestions in order to keep improving Raiders of the Broken Planet. Today, we want to share some of the most immediate actions we are taking based on the data gathered and on your own experiences.  

Player behavior and reward choices are tightly tied with how the game’s economy works. There's currently a couple issues that have been affecting the overall experience and that we're trying to correct: 

First of all, Antagonist appearances are not as random as we would like them to be. There are groups of players with a certain skill level or who are playing certain missions, that are experiencing less frequency of antagonist appearances than others. This is something that we plan to address in two ways: 

Antagonists no longer will know what map they're going to play before confirming their presence. This will not allow tactical choice of missions that would result in cancelled matches for all the other players and will also spread antagonist appearances across all maps evenly. 

We are working on modifying the matchmaking algorithm to better spread antagonist appearances across all missions. 

Secondly, player progression is not following the stable path we originally devised. The game’s reward system is influenced by several variables: Better scores give our better rewards. The inclusion of an Antagonist in the game grants a significant boost on the rewards. Blueprint drops and players’ choices have a part to play as well.  

This situation has been exacerbated by the issue discussed in the previous point as well as the fact that bonus prizes depended too much on the Antagonist presence. As a solution, we are applying a hot fix to the game’s backend that will guarantee more balanced (and slightly increased) rewards, having that criteria in mind.  

Last, but not least, we have also included the option to decrease your chances of becoming the game’s host, if you reckon your connection is not the best suited for that task.  

Please, let us know what you think of this changes, and keep sending us your feedback! 

See you on the Broken Planet, Raiders.

notes.title: Killfest Event!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448475/c2fd1b72d71d3df3bf20a3509fb025a4a6039006.jpg[/img]

[b]Calling to all Raiders! Welcome to the very first Raiders of the Broken Planet event.[/b]

[i]Harec sat staring at the components of his sniper rifle laid out in front of him, frowning upon the scattered pieces and distractedly running an oily rag over the well-used barrel. 

“This won’t do. This won’t do at all”, he muttered to himself. 

Admittedly, he had been a little too successful of late recruiting Raiders to his cause. A few months ago, it was just him and Konstantin waging a losing war against the despicable human factions. Now he had to deal with a plethora of bruised egos, cold personalities and even a terminal lunatic or two. 

Tension was mounting as the new recruits inevitably failed to bond with the rest of the team, and Harec was growing weary of playing the father figure every time two of these damned “Terrans” came to blows for every real or imagined cause. Lycus was the worst of all, challenging his leadership at any given opportunity. He needed to put an end to that, and fast, or the group will just tear itself apart. 

He had expected to find some support from Shae at least, but she had only grown colder since he had accepted Kuzmann into the team, still he lived in hope. Perhaps this was not the time or place to try to heal old wounds, he mused. 

Harec reassembled his weapon with a quick succession of expert moves, and then made up his mind. He would not try to limit his team’s aggressive tendencies. Quite the contrary. He would encourage them, and reward those who chose to vent that violence on their enemies. 

He would apply that principle to himself, he decided, leading by example and enforcing his command through his own deeds. That would shut up Lycus for a while at least…[/i]

---

Greetings Raiders!

We want to propose a little challenge for this weekend. Now that Ginebra has joined the team, the ranks of the Raiders have increased considerably, and we have fans debating the pros and cons of their preferred characters on Facebook, Twitter and in the Forums. The time has come to take action and stand by your favourite Raider to see who really is the best! 

Here at MercurySteam we have decided that it will be YOU who decide which cards get released. To that end, we will monitor all matches taking place this weekend, from Friday 10, 5:00 pm CET, to Sunday 12, 11:00pm CET. We will release a new card for the top three characters who total the most kills during the weekend.

Pretty simple, right? Just pick your character and score as many kills with him or her as you can! We will announce the results next week.

See you on the Broken Planet, Raiders.
